title: G3 minimal reproducible closed-pilot CRM deployment
objective: Package built React, the existing crm-api and durable PostgreSQL with one HTTPS origin; first operator and actor provisioning through the authoritative platform lifecycle; backup and independent restore, with no test fixtures or new services.
deliverables: built web served via Caddy HTTPS with existing /auth, /v1 and gRPC-web proxy on one origin
one Docker Compose package with private crm-api and persistent PostgreSQL plus one-shot schema migration
one-shot first tenant, active operator actors, published production capability and module installation (IMPLEMENTED, PHYSICAL ACCEPTANCE PENDING)
idempotent checksum-verified migrations and non-superuser runtime PostgreSQL role
operator environment, backup and separate fresh-environment restore commands
exact-SHA installation, browser and recovery evidence (PENDING)
acceptance: fresh installation without demo/test fixtures and with correctly provisioned real tenant and operator
one HTTPS origin with private API and PostgreSQL; authenticated create/read/update CRM and tenant/RLS denial
PostgreSQL persistence after restarts and independent restored copy with audit/outbox/tenants
tested upgrade and schema-compatible rollback, exact image digests, deployment runbook and G3 issue evidence
all exact-head CI and relevant practical checks accepted before merge
non_goals: G3 is not accepted until authoritative first-install operator provisioning and independent restore pass
no Kubernetes, alternate auth engine, generic CRUD or architectural platform expansion
no production claims from build-only or CI-only tests
